plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration and align with the conservative mandate.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU) to zero for capital preservation.
Sell METU and MSFU to reduce high-beta exposure.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall portfolio risk.
It aims for a stable, low-drawdown portfolio.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces leverage and high-beta exposure, aiming for lower volatility and drawdowns. Potential returns are modest, but so is the risk.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet concentration limits.
Reduce leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU) to small positions.
Trim METU and MSFU to reduce high-beta exposure.
Buy XLV at 4% as a strong, diversified scanner setup.
This plan balances growth with risk management, maintaining a small cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for approximately 2.5% per month, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality scanner setup. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet concentration limits.
Add to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU) to increase exposure.
Add to high-beta names (METU, MSFU) for aggressive growth.
Buy XLV at 6% as a strong scanner setup.
This plan uses leverage and concentration for stretched growth potential.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and high-beta names. Be aware of substantially higher volatility, larger potential drawdowns, and the daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Add to QQQI, targeting 30% for increased income generation.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU) to zero.
Sell METU and MSFU to reduce high-beta exposure.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and low drawdown.
It aims to park cash for yield with minimal growth focus.
income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It emphasizes income-generating ETFs and broad index exposure, cutting nearly all leverage and high-beta names. While aiming for reliable income, distributions are variable, and NAV can still decline in market downturns.
